ruleDefinitions.name: Use NTFS Short Name in Image
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid Image based detection

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.bat.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.dll.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.hta.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.js.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.msi.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.ps1.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.tmp.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.vbe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~1\\\.vbs.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.bat.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.dll.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.exe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.hta.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.js.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.msi.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.ps1.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.tmp.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.vbe.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\~2\\\.vbs.*")) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe") AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WebEx\\\\WebexHost\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\thor\\\\thor64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = "C\:\\PROGRA\~1\\WinZip\\WZPREL\~1\.EXE" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\VCREDI\\~1\\\.EXE$"))
